title: Quaint Tender Uruguayan Corn Casseroles
description: A tangy and tender Uruguayan dish featuring creamed corn, this casserole is perfect for a romantic dinner, and is also shojin-friendly, meaning it is vegetarian and avoids strong-smelling ingredients
instructions: In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat.
Add diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
In a large bowl, combine cooked onion and garlic, cream style corn, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
In a separate bowl, mix shredded cheddar cheese and crushed whole wheat crackers.
Add the cheese and cracker mixture to the corn mixture and stir until well combined.
In a small bowl, beat the eggs and then add them to the corn mixture, stirring until the eggs are fully incorporated.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and bake for 35 minutes.
